svg.title: mapo_tyre_base site plan
svg.text: mapo_tyre_base · the crew's first base, an old tyre-shop compound (ch33–98)
Site plan in metres, north up (alias tyre_yard). Hapjeong-dong, Mapo-gu, just south of Yanghwa-ro, inside hapjeong_gate_zone; about 6 minutes' walk from Hanbit Mart.
Fictional, no real address. No key: decided here from beats ch33 ("with separate rooms. Orrin sleeps under a shed roof") and scripts/ch063 (the featured bay).
SERVICE ROAD off Yanghwa-ro (Yanghwa-ro about 90 m north)
south: backs of low workshops; the Han a few hundred metres beyond
and Iron Vow at the gate

admits Orrin without a door gag (ch63).
2 Plain pegboard and tyre racks on the featured bay's east wall

med corner below; the "separate rooms" above (ch33).
